LESSON: ETHICS OF DA’WA (PROPAGATION)

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalat 6.3 Labour Relations in Islam (5 lessons) By the end of the sub-strand,
Topic 6.4: Ethics of Da’wa (propagation)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Ethics of Da’wa (propagation), part of Muamalat 6.3 Labour Relations in Islam (5 lessons) By the end of the sub-strand, in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: when they are making the tactile chart, ● role play the qualities of a da’i , learners with blindness can be 1. How can one carry out da’wa effectively?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. search online or on available reference materials for the etiquette of da’wa and make notes,

2. discuss ways of conducting da’wa peacefully and present in class,

3. assess the effective ways of using media platforms in da’wa activities,

4. brainstorm on the qualities of a da’i and present on a chart, learners with low vision can be supported to use appropriate colour contrast and font size

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. search online or on available reference materials for the etiquette of da’wa and make notes,
2. discuss ways of conducting da’wa peacefully and present in class,
3. assess the effective ways of using media platforms in da’wa activities,
4. brainstorm on the qualities of a da’i and present on a chart, learners with low vision can be supported to use appropriate colour contrast and font size

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Ethics of Da’wa (propagation) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: the skills of interacting with digital technology and connecting with technology enhanced as learners search

online for the etiquette of da’wa

● Communication and Collaboration: the skills of listening, speaking, writing and teamwork enhanced as learners brainstorm

on the qualities of a da’i and present on a chart as well as discussing ways of conducting da’wa peacefully and present in

class

● Creativity and imagination: the skill of networking enhanced as learners dramatise da’wa activities in class/school setting,

record and share on social media

● Learning to learn: the skill of sharing learnt knowledge enhanced as learners prepare short da’wa messages, record/take

photos and share on social media

Values:
● Responsibility: accountability enhanced as learners brainstorm on the qualities of a da’i and present on a chart

● Respect:ettiquette enhanced as learners respect each other’s opinions as they brainstorm on the qualities of a da’i and present

on a chart

● Unity: cooperation enhanced as learners dramatise da’wa activities in class/school setting, record and share on social media

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Life skill: the skill of self-esteem enhanced as learners dramatise da’wa activities in class/school setting, record and share

on social media
